newsitem.title: EU: EP STRESSES IMPORTANCE OF SEATBELTS IN COACHES AND BUSES.
newsitem.headline: EP STRESSES IMPORTANCE OF SEATBELTS IN COACHES AND BUSES.

text.p: EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT SESSION NEWS PRESS RELEASE
Necessity to have seatbelts in coaches and buses

Monday, 14 July - Referring to the recent coach accident in France, in which three young people lost their lives, Gary Titley (Greater Manchester West, PES) reiterated a call for pan-European legislation to oblige all coaches to be equipped with seatbelts and emphasised the need for this matter to be dealt with at a European level. He pointed out that the school concerned had a policy of using coaches which were adequately equipped. However, due to a breakdown they had been obliged to use a local coach which had no seatbelts fitted. He called upon the President to send a letter to the Council and the Commission concerning this urgent matter.
